sections.title: How an OEM program runs
sections.body: Sample timing depends on construction complexity; bulk starts after sample approval and material confirmation.
items: Brief & feasibility — Send style photos, a tech pack, or a reference sample—we confirm construction and material options.
Sampling — You receive samples for fit, hand-feel, and logo review before bulk.
Bulk production — Confirmed specs go to knitting and finishing with in-process checks.
QC & packing — Pre-shipment inspection, branded packing, and export-ready cartons.
Shipping — Documents and logistics prepared for your destination market.

customization.title: 贴牌袜定制服务
customization.description: Logo、纱线、颜色、高度与包装选择，对齐你的品牌手册——无需每季重写货盘。
customization.content: Logo, yarn, color, height, and packaging choices that match your brand book—without rewriting your assortment every season.

sections.title: Customization topics
sections.body: Choices agreed at sampling stay on the bulk order.
items: Logo & branding — Embroidery, jacquard, printed logos, hangtags, and woven labels to your artwork.
Materials & color — Cotton, bamboo, wool blends, synthetics, and custom dye lots agreed at sampling.
Construction — Height, cushion zones, rib, toe closure, and grip options tuned to the end use.
Packaging — Polybags, header cards, retail boxes, and master cartons labeled for your channel.

sections.title: Buying FAQ
sections.body: We aim to respond to inquiries within one business day.
items: What do you need for a first quote? — Style photos or tech pack, target materials, estimated quantity, destination market, and any logo or packing notes.
Do you support OEM and ODM? — Yes—produce from your design, or develop styles with our sampling team.
Can I order private label packaging? — Yes—hangtags, polybags, labels, and cartons can follow your brand standards.
How do sampling and bulk timing work? — Sample timing depends on construction complexity; bulk starts after sample approval and material confirmation.
How fast do you reply? — We aim to respond to inquiries within one business day.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content: LoftKnit uses the contact details you submit to reply to quotes and project briefs. We do not sell enquiry data. To update or delete information, write to sales@loftknit-oem.com.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: Terms for using the LoftKnit website.
terms.content: Content on this website is for product information and enquiry. Specifications and lead times are confirmed in writing on each quotation. Nothing here is a binding offer. Commercial terms sit on documents issued by LoftKnit Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
